subject.title: fix(discord): disable ws 8.21.0 receiver part limits for gateway sockets

question: Should OpenClaw disable `ws` 8.21 retained-part limits entirely for trusted Discord gateway sockets, or require finite Discord-specific caps before merging this fix?
rationale: The code path is narrow, but it trades an upstream network-input resource guard for Discord gateway availability, so maintainer intent is needed after the mechanical test drift is repaired.

options.title: Accept disabled limits after test repair
options.body: Merge the Discord-only exception once the sibling test is updated, relying on `maxPayload` as the remaining byte guard for this trusted peer.

options.title: Require finite caps
options.body: Ask for high but bounded `maxBufferedChunks` and `maxFragments` values plus proof that they cover realistic Discord gateway traffic.

options.title: Pause this mitigation
options.body: Hold or close this PR and pursue another route such as dependency pinning, an upstream `ws` change, or a fresh live reproduction-first policy.

recommendation.title: Accept disabled limits after test repair
recommendation.body: Merge the Discord-only exception once the sibling test is updated, relying on `maxPayload` as the remaining byte guard for this trusted peer.

likelyOwner.reason: He is assigned to the PR and has the strongest recent history on the Discord gateway transport and diagnostics path.
